title: Small intimate group tour just right for the Alhambra
text: We had Adriana as our guide and she’s just wonderfully full of information and be able to explain history in an interesting and engaging way. Our small group consisted of our family of three and an older couple. The small group size allowed for a more intimate discussion and move easily through the morning crowds. We started at 9 and was done by 12:30 before the crowds get too heavy. Highly recommend.

title: A fantastic tour around the magical and beautiful Alhambra Palace and gardens.
text:
A fantastic tour around the Alhambra Palace with our guide Juan.
We visited the Alhambra Palace with friends a few days ago on our second visit to Granada.
The tour was perfect with our guide explaining everything to us in a clear manner and his English was very clear too.
We chose the reduced number tour and it was well worth the small extra cost. Rather than other tours with 25/30 people, there were only six of us so we could clearly hear what was being said by Juan (through the supplied headsets) and it was easy to keep up on what was an extensive two hour tour.
I can highly recommend this
author: JeffCYork

title: Highly recommend a tour...
text: Highly recommend a tour to get a deeper appreciation of sights - Juan was prompt, got us set up with tickets and headsets efficiently, and then kept a perfect pace and level of commentary including basic info and adding interesting facts. The itinerary was well planned and included a short 10 min break halfway thru. Meeting at 9:30 meant getting through many sights and enjoying photos wo many other visitors, and before foot traffic became overwhelming. Small group meant we were a bit more nimble and relaxed.
